parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter rules for the component.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the component property. Valid values of N: 1 to 5.

sub_parameters.name: Operator
sub_parameters.description:
The comparison operator that is used to filter property values. Valid values of N: 1 to 5. Valid values:

*   Equal
*   NotEqual
*   BeginWith
*   LessThan
*   GreaterThan

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The values of properties. Valid values of the first N: 1 to 5. Valid values of the second N: 1 to 20.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

parameters.name: TypeName
parameters.description:
The name of the component. Valid values:

*   ACS:InstanceInformation
*   ACS:Application
*   ACS:File
*   ACS:Network
*   ACS:WindowsRole
*   ACS:Service
*   ACS:WindowsRegistry
*   ACS:WindowsUpdate
